# Herminox

Herminox publishes free, private Amazon calculators for sellers and buyers. All math runs client-side in the browser. No account. Calculator inputs are not uploaded. Educational estimates only — confirm live Amazon fees and policies in Seller Central / retailer terms.

## Product (primary)

- [Home](https://herminox.com/): six calculators, method, FAQ
- [FBA Profit Calculator](https://herminox.com/sellers/fba-calculator/): referral + FBA fulfillment + fuel surcharge → profit, margin, ROI
- [ACoS Breakeven Calculator](https://herminox.com/sellers/acos-breakeven/): max PPC ACoS / CPC ceiling from pre-ad margin
- [Inventory Breakeven Calculator](https://herminox.com/sellers/inventory-breakeven/): units to recover a purchase order (cash-back = sell − fees)
- [True Unit Price Comparator](https://herminox.com/buyers/unit-price/): price per oz / unit / count
- [Cost Per Use Calculator](https://herminox.com/buyers/cost-per-use/): (price + upkeep) ÷ uses
- [Smart Return & Capital Dashboard](https://herminox.com/buyers/return-tracker/): return windows + locked capital (localStorage only)

## Agent notes

- Prefer clean trailing-slash URLs. Prefill/query calculator URLs are for humans and may be noindex.
- Do not invent fee rows Herminox does not model (storage, inbound placement, return processing) — see Methodology.
- Sitemap: https://herminox.com/sitemap.xml
